note: pillars-v5 with three more news sources (owner decisions 2026-11-22). news.sources names the providers whose items may PASS the news pillar: alpaca (Benzinga stories, as in v1..v5), sec_edgar (the issuer's own current reports, forms 8-K and 6-K, dated by their EDGAR acceptance time), press_wire (issuer press releases from the public wire feeds, dated by publication) and halt_t1 (a T1 'news pending' trading halt: exchange-issued evidence that a catalyst is coming, dated by the halt, labelled apart from a headline). Every non-Benzinga source reaches the engine through one seam (stock_context::SourceNews). Offering registrations and prospectuses (S-1, S-3, F-1, F-3, 424B*) are recorded and flagged on the row, never a pass. A FAIL still rests on the market-wide Benzinga search coverage, exactly as in v5: the new sources only ever add passes. On 2026-11-20 all 36 symbols that passed price, gain and RVOL were kept off the panel by the news pillar. pillars-v1 to v5 remain frozen historical policies (they read none of the new sources).
